name: Mogami (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Mogami town emblem in white: a ring crossed by two winged horizontal bars.
history: Municipal flag of Mogami, a town in Yamagata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 8 January 1958.

features.role: Mogami town emblem — a ring crossed by two winged horizontal bars
